_comment: The frozen inputs of the demo that are not npm packages. abap2UI5 itself is the npm package @abap2ui5/node-runtime, pinned exactly in package.json and by package-lock.json - one release commit of the framework, with the commits of open-abap-core and express-icf-shim it was built against recorded in its package.json (ci/transpile.mjs checks both out at exactly those). The samples are fetched at exactly the commit below (ci/clone.mjs), and the page boots exactly this UI5 release (app/web.mjs). Nothing here moves on its own: there is no scheduled rebuild and no Dependabot. To refresh the demo, change the package version and these values by hand in one pull request and let build_web (unit tests + browser smoke) judge it. See AGENTS.md "Frozen inputs".
